title: Renting vs. Buying a Home: The 5% Rule
summary: Ben Felix explains how to compare renting and buying a home by looking at unrecoverable costs, and distills it into the 5% rule of thumb. It is framed for a Canadian audience but broadly applicable.
why: HN points to it for a clean first-order framework for the rent versus buy decision.

quote.text: This guy breaks down the analysis very cleanly to a first-order approximation, using 2019 figures
